results.title: Darlings
results.overview: Badru hopes her volatile husband will reform if he stops drinking. But when his rage goes too far, she and her mom boldly, albeit clumsily, seek revenge.

results.title: M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story
results.overview: Based on the life story of Mahendra Singh Dhoni, and his journey to being the world cup winning captain of the Indian cricket team.

results.title: Ek Villain Returns
results.overview: When a singer goes missing amid a serial killing spree, a cabbie and a businessman's son cross paths in a twisted tale where good and evil is blurred.

results.title: Delhi Belly
results.overview: Three unsuspecting, average guys find themselves on the hit list of one of India's most-powerful crime syndicates.

results.title: Badla
results.overview: A dynamic young entrepreneur finds herself locked in a hotel room with the corpse of her dead lover. She hires a prestigious lawyer to defend her and they work together to figure out what actually happened.

results.title: Bachchhan Paandey
results.overview: A budding director tries to research a merciless gangster for making a film on gangsterism. But her secret attempts to conduct the research fail when she gets caught for snooping.

results.title: Vadh
results.overview: Shambhunath Mishra, a retired middle school teacher is living a mundane middle-class life with his wife Manju Mishra in Gwalior. Life takes a complete turn for the Mishra family when a situation gets out of hand and it leads to a killing at the hands of Shambhunath Mishra. Mishra ji has very little time to plan cautiously to turn this into a “perfect murder” and leave no trace behind.

results.title: Drive
results.overview: A notorious thief allies with a street racer for a grand heist involving an elaborate game of deceit with authorities, who have their own dirty secrets.

results.title: Mangal Pandey - The Rising
results.overview: The film begins in 1857, when India was ruled by the British East India Company. Mangal Pandey is a sepoy, a soldier of Indian origin, in the army of the East India Company. Pandey is fighting in the Anglo-Afghan Wars and saves the life of his British commanding officer, William Gordon. Gordon is indebted to Pandey and a strong friendship develops between them, transcending both rank and race.

results.title: Golmaal Again
results.overview: Gopal and his best friends are back again, and this time they move back to their old neighborhood in a new palatial house where they learn that it is being haunted by a ghost.

results.title: Billu
results.overview: When a famous Bollywood actor visits a small village for a film's shoot, a poor hairdresser's claim that they were once childhood friends soon makes him the centre of attention.

results.title: ABCD 2
results.overview: Childhood friends Suresh and Vinnie want to become successful dancers. To fulfill their dreams, they form a dance group with their friends and compete in a hip-hop contest in Las Vegas.

results.title: Bhakshak
results.overview: A struggling local journalist begins a dogged investigation into harrowing cases of abuse being covered up at a shelter for young girls.

results.title: Guzaarish
results.overview: Ethan, a magician rendered paralyzed in an accident, sets off a furor when he makes a petition to the court to end his own life.

results.title: A Night of Knowing Nothing
results.original_title: कुछ भी न जानने की एक रात
results.overview: L, a student in India witness to the government's violent response to university protests, writes letters to her estranged lover while he is away.

results.title: Lakshya
results.overview: An aimless, jobless, irresponsible grown man joins the army and matures into a battlefield hero.

results.title: Darr
results.overview: A woman is caught between one man's love and another man's obsession. She fears one and fears for the other. One stands for love and the other for life. Who will she choose?

results.title: Vivah
results.overview: Poonam, a traditionally brought-up young woman, is to marry Prem, a groom chosen by her uncle. Poonam and Prem's faith and love are to be tested however, when an accident occurs and Poonam might be scarred for life.

results.title: Gunjan Saxena: The Kargil Girl
results.overview: Inspired by the life of a fearless young officer who made history by becoming the first Indian female Air Force officer to fly in a combat zone during the 1999 Kargil War

results.title: Boss
results.overview: Disowned by his father as a boy, Surya is taken in by a crime boss. When his brother Shiv is wrongly imprisoned, his father pleads for Surya's help.
